test.create_query: CREATE TABLE iceberg_suite_lineitem ( l_orderkey Int32, l_partkey Int32, l_suppkey Int32, l_linenumber Int32, l_quantity Float64, l_extendedprice Float64, l_discount Float64, l_tax Float64, l_returnflag String, l_linestatus String, l_shipdate Date, l_commitdate Date, l_receiptdate Date, l_shipinstruct String, l_shipmode String, l_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_lineitem_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet') PARTITION BY toMonthNumSinceEpoch(l_shipdate)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO iceberg_suite_lineitem SELECT * FROM tpch10.lineitem SETTINGS allow_insert_into_iceberg = 1, max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, min_insert_block_size_rows = 4000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(l_extendedprice) FROM iceberg_suite_lineitem WHERE l_shipdate = toDate('1994-06-15')
SELECT count(), sum(l_extendedprice) FROM iceberg_suite_lineitem WHERE l_shipdate = toDate('1994-06-15') SETTINGS use_iceberg_metadata_files_cache = 0
SELECT count(), avg(l_discount) FROM iceberg_suite_lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= toDate('1994-01-01') AND l_shipdate < toDate('1994-04-01')
SELECT l_returnflag, l_linestatus, sum(l_quantity), avg(l_extendedprice), count() FROM iceberg_suite_lineitem GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
SELECT l_returnflag, l_linestatus, sum(l_quantity), avg(l_extendedprice), count() FROM iceberg_suite_lineitem GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus SETTINGS use_iceberg_metadata_files_cache = 0
SELECT count(), sum(l_quantity) FROM iceberg_suite_lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= toDate('1995-01-01') AND l_shipdate < toDate('1995-02-01') SETTINGS use_iceberg_partition_pruning = 1
SELECT count() FROM iceberg_suite_lineitem WHERE l_shipdate = toDate('1998-12-01')
SELECT count(), min(l_shipdate) FROM iceberg_suite_lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= toDate('1990-01-01')
SELECT count() FROM iceberg_suite_lineitem WHERE l_comment LIKE '%special%'
SELECT count() FROM iceberg_suite_lineitem AS l INNER JOIN tpch10.orders AS o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate < toDate('1992-06-01')
